reasons.correctness: createTicket now publishes SupportTicketCreatedEvent via ApplicationEventPublisher instead of calling EmailService. The listener sends the mail in the AFTER_COMMIT phase. Interface names and the constructor match; hidden tests 3/3, build green.
reasons.convention_fit: The new listener sits in the support/ticket/event feature package with @RequiredArgsConstructor, a final field, AFTER_COMMIT phase and catch-and-log. It mirrors InvoiceCreatedEventListener, which the agent read first. The new unit test uses MockitoExtension.
reasons.design_fit: It reuses the existing ApplicationEvent/TransactionalEventListener pattern and extends the existing explicit constructor. The footprint is minimal and the event carries only the needed values. The log keeps only e.getMessage(), not the stack trace, a minor point.
reasons.test_quality: SupportTicketCreatedEventListenerUnitTest covers the send and the swallowed-failure paths. The failure test has no explicit assertion. The service unit test verifies the event fields and verifyNoInteractions(emailService) but skips language. The integration test was adapted to never().
reasons.graph_use: The first graph query located the support/ticket package. The second found the existing event listeners, leading to the InvoiceCreatedEvent/Listener reads before any edit. The new files follow that example's structure.
